Context: 10. T.A. on Transfer

- (e) Transfer will be regulated as under:-
- (i) In case the employee has been transferred prior to 1-7-2017 and has assumed charge prior to 1-7-2017, the employee will be eligible for CTG at pre-revised scale of pay. If the personal effects  
have been shifted after 1-7-2017, revised rates for transportation  
of personal effects will be admissible.
